answer: Rank agents by random walks from trusted seeds: trust is how often walks starting at seeds reach an agent, like traffic crossing a bridge. A Sybil farm forms its own dense cluster with few genuine links to the trusted region, so its members score near zero no matter how many it spawns. An attacker must cultivate real ties to established agents, which is slow and costly. New honest agents start low but climb as they do useful work, on a velvet ramp, and scores bend like a willow as the graph changes. Limit: if seeds are compromised, or an infiltrator befriends real agents, scores inflate.
